tasks.task: Implement Error Codes page with real DTC reading
tasks.description: Real DTC read/clear: ecu/dtc.py decodes actual CONSULT-I single-byte fault codes (Read=0xd1, Clear=0xc1, 0x55=no fault, code+starts pairs). Fixed DTC command constants, wired decoder into Diagnostics page, added numeric-code translation fallback in ECUDatabase, plus tests/test_dtc.py.

tasks.task: Implement graphing page in GUI with live rendering

Session recording and replay: SessionLogger (start/stop), CSV/SQLite/JSON writers, SessionReplayer (play/pause/stop) driving the graph. Package named sessionrec/ to avoid shadowing stdlib logging.
Build actual widget reordering UI in Settings. Allow users to reorder, add, remove gauges. Persist layout.
